Read mortality data from ONS-format Excel files

Source: R/ons_helpers.R
read_ons_excel.Rd

Reads UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) death registration and population data from Excel files and returns a mort_data object. Handles IMD decile-to-quintile mapping, cause column aggregation, population forward-filling, and array construction.

Usage

read_ons_excel(deaths_file, pop_files, config)

# Deprecated alias

Arguments

deaths_file

Path to the Excel file with death registration data (Sheet 1).

pop_files

Character vector of paths to population Excel files (Sheet 2, one file per year). Multiple files are stacked.

config

A mort_config object specifying cause columns, age groups, year range, etc.

Value

A mort_data object.

Note

This function is specific to the UK ONS data format. For generic mortality data, use read_mortality() instead.
